clauses.quote: Any use which violates state or federal law relating to copyright, trade secrets, the distribution of obscene or pornaceous materials, or which violates any other applicable law or municipal ordinance, is strictly prohibited.
clauses.subject_text: Any use which violates state or federal law relating to copyright, trade secrets, the distribution of obscene or pornaceous materials, or which violates any other applicable law or municipal ordinance

clauses.quote: Personally identifiable information concerning students may not be disclosed or used in any way on the Internet without the permission of a parent or guardian or, if the student is 18 or over, the permission of the student himselt7herself.
clauses.notes: Passive construction; implicit agent is school personnel/employees bound by district policy.

clauses.quote: Users should never give out private or confidential information about themselves or others on the Internet, particularly credit card numbers and Social Security numbers.
clauses.notes: In a staff policy manual, 'Users' refers to employees. 'Should never' functions as a behavioral restriction.

clauses.quote: A supervising teacher or administrator may authorize the release of directory information, as defined by Ohio law, for internal administrative purposes or approved educational projects and activities.
clauses.notes: Discretionary authority held by management personnel for internal operations.

clauses.quote: The School, either by itself or in combination with the Data Acquisition Site providing Internet access, will utilize filtering software or 'other technologies to prevent students from accessing visual depictions that are (1) obscene, (2) child pornography, or (3) harmful to minors.
clauses.subject_text: The School, either by itself or in combination with the Data Acquisition Site providing Internet access
clauses.notes: Contractual future tense 'will' imposes a mandatory duty to implement safety/privacy measures.

clauses.quote: The School will also monitor the online activities of students, through direct observation and/or technological means, to ensure that students are not accessing such depictions or any other material which is inappropriate for minors.

Internet filtering software or other technology-based protection systems may be disabled by a supervising teacher or school administrator, as necessary, for purposes of bona fide research or other. educational projects being conducted by students age 17 and older.
clauses.subject_text: Internet filtering software or other technology-based protection systems
clauses.notes: Passive voice; grants discretionary authority to management to override safety filters for specific academic purposes.
